name: g-cloud
title: Google Cloud CLI
subtitle: Manage your Google Cloud resources without opening a browser
description: Manage Google Cloud projects, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Composer (Airflow), secrets and gcloud configurations.
author: ojowwalker77

commands.name: index
commands.title: Google Cloud
commands.subtitle: Unified Google Cloud Management
commands.description: Unified Google Cloud management - access Compute, Storage, IAM, Network, and Secrets from one place

commands.name: configurations
commands.title: Settings & Configuration
commands.subtitle: Manage gcloud configs & extension settings
commands.description: List, switch, create, duplicate, and delete named gcloud configurations. Manage extension settings.

commands.name: composer
commands.title: Composer Environments
commands.subtitle: Cloud Composer
commands.description: Browse Cloud Composer (managed Airflow) environments in any project you can access: DAGs, runs, task logs, failures, performance history and dataset lineage. Read-only.

commands.name: composer-dags
commands.title: Search Airflow DAGs
commands.subtitle: Cloud Composer
commands.description: Search Airflow DAGs across the Cloud Composer environments in the current project, filtering by env:, dag:, tag:, owner:, is:failed and more.

commands.name: composer-failures
commands.title: Recent Airflow Failures
commands.subtitle: Cloud Composer
commands.description: Failed Airflow DAG runs in a recent window, across the Cloud Composer environments in the current project.

commands.name: composer-datasets
commands.title: Airflow Datasets & Lineage
commands.subtitle: Cloud Composer
commands.description: Browse Airflow datasets (data-aware scheduling): producers, consumers, events and end-to-end DAG lineage.

commands.name: composer-performance
commands.title: Airflow DAG Performance
commands.subtitle: Cloud Composer
commands.description: Typical DAG and task durations (p50/p90), slow-run regressions and failures per Cloud Composer environment.

commands.name: composer-import-errors
commands.title: Airflow Import Errors
commands.subtitle: Cloud Composer
commands.description: DAG files that fail to parse in the Cloud Composer environments of the current project.

commands.name: composer-discover
commands.title: Discover Composer Environments
commands.subtitle: Cloud Composer
commands.description: Scan the projects you can access (filtered by a name pattern) for Cloud Composer environments.

commands.name: composer-status
commands.title: Airflow Failures Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Cloud Composer
commands.description: Menu bar count of failed Airflow DAG runs in the last 24 hours, per Cloud Composer environment.

preferences.name: gcloudPath
preferences.title: gcloud CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to auto-detect, or specify custom path to gcloud executable

preferences.name: defaultRegion
preferences.title: Default Region
preferences.description: Default GCP region for new resources (e.g., us-central1, europe-west1)

preferences.name: preferredIDE
preferences.title: Default IDE
preferences.description: IDE for opening files (e.g., logs, configs)
